text: Founded in 2006 the Reading Circle is a community-based, non-profit reading program in Scarborough-Agincourt that offers free 90 minutes reading services to children ages 4-12 at Bridlewood Library from October through May. The well attended program provides active and engaging activities to reflect the different weekly themes for example Black History Month, eye health, Easter, Halloween and community safety. Enables local high school students to earn their volunteer hours and develop important skills such as communication, teamwork, engaging with young children and leadership.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Received a presentation from the Reading Circle, a community based, non-profit reading program in Scarborough-Agincourt.
